tier_reason: Peer-reviewed IEEE TCAD 2025 paper, shipped in the repo as doc/tcad.pdf, measures CKTSO against NICSLU and oneMKL PARDISO on 56 circuit matrices on a Xeon Gold 6130; the README's KLU figures remain first-party.

corrections.claimed_speedup: IEEE TCAD 2025 paper (doc/tcad.pdf), 56 SuiteSparse circuit matrices, Xeon Gold 6130, best case where fast refactorization never re-pivots: 5.9x over NICSLU and 11.9x over oneMKL PARDISO at 16 threads, about 20% lower when 10% of runs re-pivot. README (first-party, no hardware): more than 3x over sequential KLU and more than 25x with 16 threads; the 2022 results PDF shows about 2.8x and 14.6x over KLU.

corrections.stars_or_usage: 40 stars; subject of ACM TOMS 2018 / arXiv 1607.00145. TCL uses TTGT, not GETT (GETT is planned there 'eventually').
